roughStoneInventory.why: NOT REASSIGNED BY DEFAULT, and here is why. release_pbr_architecture.spec.json assigns MI_PBR_RoughStone by profileMapping.ground and by sourceNameOverrides {contains: 'foundation' -> 'foundations read as rough-hewn masonry'}. It is the ground/foundation profile, at TilingCm 250 with the castle_wall_slates texture set - not a finished wall face. Herodian drafted-margin ashlar is the dressed outer face of a retaining wall; putting it on foundations and ground would claim dressing where the model means rubble. Every RoughStone slot is enumerated into the plan and every receipt (actor label, folder, mesh) so a human can look; pass -HerodianV4IncludeRoughStone to send them to AshlarWeathered if the inspection says they are wall.
